unresolved.reason: Current Portal Único visa-free and prior-visa schedules omit this nationality. The corrected 2026 Gazette republication is a named prior-visa Annex and does not create a residual complement. The prior-visa page directs an unlisted traveller to a Cabo Verde embassy or consular post, but does not establish a nationality rule. EASE pre-registration and TSA support security/airport processing, not an ETA or visa issuance; the immigration authority's generic border tourist-visa competence is not a nationality-mapped arrival route. The fallback status is unresolved.

The 23 January 2026 corrected Gazette republication says the prior 2025 Dispatch was published inaccurately and its corrected 91-country prior-visa Annex removes this nationality. Removal from that corrected list does not establish visa-free, visa on arrival, advance visa, ETA or eVisa treatment; no complement is inferred. Current Portal Único schedules provide no alternative nationality route, while EASE pre-registration/TSA and generic border tourist-visa competence do not establish one. The fallback status is unresolved.
